data.name: Tulshi
data.gender_notes: Tulshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tulshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tulasi', which means 'the one who brings prosperity'. This name is often associated with the lotus flower and the goddess Tulsi, who is revered in Hinduism for her healing properties and for bringing good fortune to those who worship her. The name Tulshi carries the meaning “Fortune, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tulshi usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tulshi is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of prosperity, healing, and good fortune. It is believed that those named Tulshi are blessed with the ability to bring abundance and happiness to those around them.
data.etymology: Tulshi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tulshi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tulshi holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, where the Tulasi plant is considered sacred and is placed in homes, temples, and sacred spaces. The name itself is associated with prosperity, good luck, and well-being. In various Hindu mythologies, Tulasi is also considered the embodiment of Vishnu's consort Lakshmi, who represents wealth, abundance, and fortune. Naming a child Tulshi is a way of passing on these values and invoking the blessings of the goddess Tulasi.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tulshi has deep significance as it is associated with the divine and the eternal. Tulasi is not just a name or a plant, but a symbol of purity, devotion, and faith. The name Tulshi removes negative energies and infuses the child with the blessings of the goddess Tulasi, who is believed to have the power to heal, protect, and bestow prosperity. The name serves as a reminder to live a virtuous life and to bring positivity and happiness to oneself and others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tulshi: Radiating prosperity and auspiciousness. A name bestowed with blessings for a fulfilling and prosperous life.
